body.name: subset-memoized global pivot recursion
body.construction: Initialize \(S=\varnothing\), \(R_S=Q\), and \(M_{e,S}=\Delta_e\).  A label \(j\notin S\) is admissible when \(q=(R_S)_{jj}>0\), \(m_e=(M_{e,S})_{jj}\ge0\), and \(q(M_{e,S})_{:j}=m_e(R_S)_{:j}\) for every \(1\le e\le E\); with \(u=(R_S)_{:j}/q\), update \(R_{S\cup\{j\}}=R_S-quu^{\mathsf T}\) and \(M_{e,S\cup\{j\}}=M_{e,S}-m_euu^{\mathsf T}\), memoizing only \(S\cup\{j\}\).
